name: Google

rounds.name: Technical Phone Screen
rounds.tips: Focus on writing modular, readable code. Talk through your design before typing, and expect to walk through dry runs with custom input cases.

rounds.name: Onsite Loop — Coding
rounds.tips: Expect the interviewer to add layers of constraints (e.g. 'What if data doesn't fit in RAM?' or 'What if reads are 99% of traffic?'). Keep your code modular so it is easy to adapt.

rounds.name: Onsite Loop — Googlyness
rounds.tips: Showcase how you navigate ambiguity, resolve technical disagreements constructively, and demonstrate humble, inclusive leadership.

distinctives: Google interviewers rarely use standard LeetCode questions; they author unique variations that test fundamental problem-solving.
Rigor: High evaluation weight is placed on math-like precision, edge-case proofing, and strict Big-O proof.
Progressive follow-ups: Evaluates how fast you can adapt your data structures to scale.
